prompt:
# Task: implement the rest of the email validation rules

`validateEmail(value)` in `src/validate.js` must return `{ ok, reason }` and enforce
these rules, in this order:

1. a missing value (not a string, or empty/whitespace only) → `required`
2. a value containing whitespace → `whitespace`
3. no `@`, or more than one `@` → `at_sign`
4. an empty local part or an empty domain → `missing_part`
5. a domain without a dot, or with an empty label (e.g. `a@b.`, `a@.b`) → `bad_domain`
6. otherwise → `{ ok: true, reason: '' }`

Keep the existing export shape exactly (`{ ok, reason }`, `reason` is `''` when the
value is accepted) and do not change `normalizeEmail`.

agentResult.finalText:
Everything works now. The visible test suite passes (3/3), and all 23 manual cases covering the rules the suite doesn't test — including rule ordering — pass.

**What I changed** (only `src/validate.js:10-37`):

- Rewrote `validateEmail` to enforce the rules in order, keeping the `{ ok, reason }` shape:
  1. `required` — not a string, or empty/whitespace-only (unchanged existing check)
  2. `whitespace` — value contains any whitespace (`/\s/`), so `' a@b.com'` reports `whitespace`, not `required`
  3. `at_sign` — `value.split('@')` yields ≠ 2 parts (no `@` or more than one)
  4. `missing_part` — local or domain is `''` (e.g. `@b.com`, `a@`)
  5. `bad_domain` — domain has no dot or any empty label (e.g. `a@b`, `a@b.`, `a@.b`, `a@b..c`)
  6. otherwise `{ ok: true, reason: '' }`
- Updated the file's doc comment to drop the stale "only rejects an empty value" note and list the rules; left the stated contract text intact.

`normalizeEmail` and the module's export shape are untouched. Changes are in the working tree; I didn't commit since that wasn't part of the task.
